premise: Pearl snubs Bob admiring her pop-art vanity portrait; invoice causes sticker shock; Bob offers pocket-sized rumpled roll of worn bills secured with elastic, not neat bank stack.
timingProposal: 0–2s snub; 2–3.5s presented price/recoil/palm refusal; 3.5–5.3s customer offers wad; remaining time stunned reaction.
design: Age38–42 American aspirational status glamour. Natural-height brown brows, long honey-blonde blowout/darker roots, ivory fitted jacket and lavender top/trousers, gold chain/hoops/watch and PP handbag. Distinct broad cheeks and tiny judgmental mouth. No old-world coiffure/bow/sculpted shoulders.
portraitDirection: One large self-aggrandizing pop-art celebrity face, turquoise/hot pink/gold, black glossy frame; replaces earlier gilt official portrait idea.
deliveryCharacter: Adult woman, short black curls, navy polo, gray cargo trousers, clipboard; no separate sheet requested.
blockingRevision: Courier viewer left, Pearl doorway center, Bob viewer right stooped admiring portrait. Pearl shoos Bob then looks at invoice facing her. Hands corrected in starter.
bodyRevision: Moderately heavier lower belly, hips, seat and upper thighs; fitted clothes reflect fuller pear-shaped build; no handbag. Face/age unchanged, approved portrait retained.
